highlights.title: A step the bot recovered from now says Retried
highlights.text: When a command fails and the bot tries again, the step shows a grey Retried instead of a red Failed. Steps say what they did in plain words, and the exact command is one tap away under Show command.

highlights.title: Stop now says it stopped
highlights.text: Press Stop and the chat shows a short Stopped line from the bot, with the steps it had taken. A question you stopped no longer looks answered.

highlights.title: One quiet line shows who answers
highlights.text: When you ask a team, one line now says who got it and why. Tap Who else to see the other bots that could answer.

highlights.title: A new bot needs only a name and a job
highlights.text: The New bot form now asks for a name and what the bot should do. The avatar follows the job. Persona, model, personality and the rest wait under More options.

highlights.title: Space icons now match kwant's pixel look
highlights.text: The icons for your spaces are drawn in the same pixel style as your bots, in each space's own colour. Your spaces keep their icons; nothing to change.

highlights.title: Connecting an app gives it to your bots
highlights.text: When you connect an app like Gmail for the first time, every bot in the space gets it, turned on. Press Choose bots to pick fewer.

fixes: Telegram catches up after a busy moment: questions and approvals still arrive, closed cards lose their buttons.
A busy server no longer loses the push or webhook notice that a bot is waiting for your approval.
A chat no longer stays on "getting started" after a missed reply end, and a stuck bot is stopped with a short line.
Keyboard users can skip past the sidebar, reach long code blocks with Tab, and stay inside New bot while it is open.
